layout_sources: https://tiller.com/export-us-bank-transactions/ (Date, Transaction, Name, Memo, Amount; debits negative)
https://beancount.io/tools/csv-to-beancount/us-bank (five columns, Memo a filler, Name the payee; ISO dates and two decimals now, month-first dates and four decimals in older exports)
notes: "Date","Transaction","Name","Memo","Amount", every field quoted. Transaction is DEBIT or CREDIT, Amount signed (money out negative), Memo the same filler on every row. Dates YYYY-MM-DD with two decimals as recent reports say; older exports wrote M/D/YYYY and four decimals ("-15.4900"). Newest first and CRLF assumed. No balance in the file.
